stem: Meena keeps some dry moong seeds in a jar in her kitchen. When she soaks a few of them in water overnight, they begin to sprout small roots. Why should the dry moong seeds be classified as living things?

options.text: They are living because they can germinate and grow into new plants under suitable conditions.
They are living because they are hard and dry and do not change over time.
They are non-living because they do not move from one place to another on their own.
They are non-living because they were once part of a plant that has now been harvested.

teacher.key_rationale: A seed is living because, given suitable conditions such as water and warmth, it germinates and grows into a new plant that can continue the life cycle; dryness or lack of visible movement does not make it non-living. Correct option: A.
